rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved, Oregon Board-approved or ACCME-accredited programs; cultural competency CPE approved by the Oregon Health Authority (ORS 413.450) or any cultural competency CPE
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed less than one year before July 1 of the renewal period: 16 h (licensed Jul–Sep of the even year), 12 h (Oct–Dec), 8 h (Jan–Mar of the odd year) or 4 h (Apr–Jun), any topic.
rules.audit_note: ACPE credit must be in NABP CPE Monitor; Board-approved or ACCME credit goes into CPE Monitor or is uploaded to the eGov profile. Keep documentation 6 years. Missing CPE found at audit leads to discipline.

topics.who: Patient safety or medication error prevention
Course from the Oregon Pain Management Commission (OHA); attest and upload the certificate; also needed for initial licensure

rules.notes: Licenses expire June 30 of odd years; CPE period runs July 1 – June 30 of the two-year cycle. 7 mandatory hours + 23 other pharmacy hours. Reporting via NABP CPE Monitor / eGov upload.
